name: CLIProxyAPI
description: Run a managed local gateway for Gemini CLI, Codex, Claude, Antigravity, Kimi and xAI accounts, then use its discovered models in Vetta.
setup.title: Local model gateway
setup.subtitle: Vetta manages the pinned local runtime. This plugin owns every CLIProxyAPI route, OAuth flow, account view and model-to-protocol mapping.
setup.oauthWaiting: Finish authorization in the provider page. This plugin is polling the local CLIProxyAPI service.
setup.oauthSuccess: Authorization completed. Accounts and models are being refreshed.
setup.replaceHint: This setup panel remains available. Reauthorizing adds or updates an account; to fully replace one, remove the old account first and then authorize the new account above. If the provider page signs into the old account automatically, switch or sign out there.
setup.removeLocalOnly: Removal deletes the credential stored by CLIProxyAPI on this device. It does not revoke access on the provider website.
